title: Body Electric

A direct address to the viewer/listener from a virtual assistant. The new ambient intelligence promises security, rapid response, predictive analysis, microgeneration, efficiency. Here it delivers funwashing messages from the cloud for users in a performative essay on domotics. Talk back from the data harvest and Orwell’s “never sleeping ear.” To challenge them is to “fight the future.”

Based on an semi-autobiographical original script, A Woman Asleep takes an essayistic form, echoing Resnais, Marker, Antonioni, and Akerman as fiction, memory, and reflection blur.

With 70s needle drops, an original score by Sonny Luca, and original music by lead actor and co-writer/director C.M. Sutton, watching IN THE EVER feels like listening to a complete album.

title: Craftswoman: Weaving Life Whole
overview: Craftswoman: Weaving Life Whole is an intimate, "embodied" documentary offering a reprieve from our fast-paced and disconnected world. Directed by a filmmaker and textile artist exploring questions about what in our lives gives us a sense of wholeness, the film shifts the focus from the final product to the healing power of “process” itself. Filmed over six months under the pace of trust, the project follows four Finnish craftswomen finding meaning in the rhythm of ancestral craft. Letting go of the typical rush of film production, the filmmaker uses a slow, spacious approach to storytelling—inviting audiences to drop from their analytical minds into their felt senses, and to remember that we already have everything we need to feel whole.

title: My Chemical Romance Live: Long Live the Black Parade at the Hollywood Bowl

title: Gredos - King of the Mountains

Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns. Alongside it, golden eagles, alpine birds and otters inhabit a territory shaped by isolation and resilience. This is a portrait of wilderness and balance, a window into one of Europe's last great wild spaces.
